question.worked_solution:
The formula for the derivative of the inverse hyperbolic secant function is

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arsech}⁡x)=-\frac{1}{x\sqrt{1-{x}^{2}}}.
$$

Using the formula above with the chain rule, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}[-4\operatorname{arsech}⁡(x-1)] \\  & =-4\cdot [-\frac{1}{(x-1)\sqrt{1-(x-1)^{2}}}]\cdot (x-1)^{′} \\  & =\frac{4}{(x-1)\sqrt{1-({x}^{2}-2x+1)}}\cdot 1 \\  & =\frac{4}{(x-1)\sqrt{2x-{x}^{2}}} \\  & =\frac{4}{(x-1)\sqrt{\,x(2-x)\,}}.\end{aligned}
$$
